lines: 善人给子孙遗留产业；
罪人为义人积存资财。
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children
but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
善人给子孙遗留产业；
罪人为义人积存资财。
善人給子孫遺留產業；
罪人為義人積存資財。
A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children
but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
The heritage of the good man is handed down to his children's children; and the wealth of the sinner is stored up for the upright man.
你们的言语要常常带着和气，
好像用盐调和，就可知道该怎样回答各人。
Let your speech always be with grace
seasoned with salt
that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
你们的言语要常常带着和气，
好像用盐调和，就可知道该怎样回答各人。
你們的言語要常常帶着和氣，
好像用鹽調和，就可知道該怎樣回答各人。
Let your speech always be with grace
seasoned with salt
that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
Let your talk be with grace
mixed with salt
so that you may be able to give an answer to everyone.
从来没有人恨恶自己的身子，
总是保养顾惜，正像基督待教会一样，
For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it
even as the Lord also does the assembly;
从来没有人恨恶自己的身子，
总是保养顾惜，正像基督待教会一样，
從來沒有人恨惡自己的身子，
總是保養顧惜，正像基督待教會一樣，
For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it
even as the Lord also does the assembly;
For no man ever had hate for his flesh; but he gives it food and takes care of it
even as Christ does for the church;
不可剃头，也不可容发绺长长，
只可剪发。
“‘“They shall not shave their heads
or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.
不可剃头，也不可容发绺长长，
只可剪发。
不可剃頭，也不可容髮綹長長，
只可剪髮。
“‘“They shall not shave their heads
or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.
They are not to have all the hair cut off their heads
and they are not to let their hair get long
but they are to have the ends of their hair cut.
不可使头光秃；不可剃除胡须的周围，
也不可用刀划身。
“‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
不可使头光秃；不可剃除胡须的周围，
也不可用刀划身。
不可使頭光禿；不可剃除鬍鬚的周圍，
也不可用刀劃身。
“‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
They are not to have their hair cut off for the dead
or the hair on their chins cut short
or make cuts in their flesh.
往来传舌的，泄漏密事；
大张嘴的，不可与他结交。
He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
往来传舌的，泄漏密事；
大张嘴的，不可与他结交。
往來傳舌的，洩漏密事；
大張嘴的，不可與他結交。
He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
He who goes about talking of the business of others gives away secrets: so have nothing to do with him whose lips are open wide.
因为我所作的，我自己不明白；
我所愿意的，我并不作；
我所恨恶的，我倒去作。
For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate
that I do.
因为我所作的，我自己不明白；
我所愿意的，我并不作；
我所恨恶的，我倒去作。
因為我所作的，我自己不明白；
我所願意的，我並不作；
我所恨惡的，我倒去作。
For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate
that I do.
And I have no clear knowledge of what I am doing
for that which I have a mind to do
I do not
but what I have hate for
that I do.

神看着一切所造的都甚好。有晚上，
有早晨，是第六日。
God saw everything that he had made
and
behold
it was very good. There was evening and there was morning
a sixth day.

有早晨，是第六日。
神看着一切所造的都甚好。有晚上，
有早晨，是第六日。
God saw everything that he had made
and
behold
it was very good. There was evening and there was morning
a sixth day.
And God saw everything which he had made and it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning
the sixth day.

他就赐他们权柄，作神的儿女。
But as many as received him
to them he gave the right to become God’s children
to those who believe in his name:
凡接待他的，就是信他名的人，
他就赐他们权柄，作神的儿女。
凡接待他的，就是信他名的人，
他就賜他們權柄，作神的兒女。
But as many as received him
to them he gave the right to become God’s children
to those who believe in his name:
To all those who did so take him
however
he gave the right of becoming children of God--that is
to those who had faith in his name:

That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth

Not that which goes into the mouth makes a man unclean
but that which comes out of the mouth.
神所赐出人意外的平安，
必在基督耶稣里保守你们的心怀意念。
And the peace of God
which surpasses all understanding
will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
神所赐出人意外的平安，
必在基督耶稣里保守你们的心怀意念。
神所賜出人意外的平安，
必在基督耶穌裏保守你們的心懷意念。
And the peace of God
which surpasses all understanding
will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
And the peace of God
which is deeper than all knowledge
will keep your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.
我们若照他的旨意求甚么，
他就听我们，这是我们向他所存坦然无惧的心。
This is the boldness which we have toward him
that
if we ask anything according to his will
he listens to us.
我们若照他的旨意求甚么，
他就听我们，这是我们向他所存坦然无惧的心。
我們若照他的旨意求甚麼，
他就聽我們，這是我們向他所存坦然無懼的心。
This is the boldness which we have toward him
that
if we ask anything according to his will
he listens to us.
And we are certain that if we make any request to him which is right in his eyes
he will give ear to us:
盗贼来，无非要偷窃，
杀害，毁坏；我来了，是要叫羊得生命，
并且得的更丰盛。
The thief only comes to steal
kill
and destroy. I came that they may have life
and may have it abundantly.
盗贼来，无非要偷窃，
杀害，毁坏；我来了，是要叫羊得生命，
并且得的更丰盛。
盜賊來，無非要偷竊，
殺害，毀壞；我來了，是要叫羊得生命，
並且得的更豐盛。
The thief only comes to steal
kill
and destroy. I came that they may have life
and may have it abundantly.
The thief comes only to take the sheep and to put them to death: he comes for their destruction: I have come so that they may have life and have it in greater measure.
因你胃口不清，屡次患病，
再不要照常喝水，可以稍微用点酒。
Be no longer a drinker of water only
but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
因你胃口不清，屡次患病，
再不要照常喝水，可以稍微用点酒。
因你胃口不清，屢次患病，
再不要照常喝水，可以稍微用點酒。
Be no longer a drinker of water only
but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
Do not take only water as your drink
but take a little wine for the good of your stomach
and because you are frequently ill.
使徒大有能力，见证主耶稣复活；
众人也都蒙大恩。
With great power
the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.
使徒大有能力，见证主耶稣复活；
众人也都蒙大恩。
使徒大有能力，見證主耶穌復活；
眾人也都蒙大恩。
With great power
the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.
And with great power the Apostles gave witness of the coming back of the Lord Jesus from the dead; and grace was on them all.

又有虹围着宝座，好像绿宝石。
that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne
like an emerald to look at.
看那坐着的，好像碧玉和红宝石；
又有虹围着宝座，好像绿宝石。
看那坐着的，好像碧玉和紅寶石；
又有虹圍着寶座，好像綠寶石。
that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne
like an emerald to look at.
And to my eyes he was like a jasper and a sardius stone: and there was an arch of light round the high seat
like an emerald.
你们作父亲的，不要惹儿女的气，
只要照着主的教训和警戒养育他们。
You fathers
don’t provoke your children to wrath
but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
你们作父亲的，不要惹儿女的气，
只要照着主的教训和警戒养育他们。
你們作父親的，不要惹兒女的氣，
只要照着主的教訓和警戒養育他們。
You fathers
don’t provoke your children to wrath
but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
And
you fathers
do not make your children angry: but give them training in the teaching and fear of the Lord.
不可忘记用爱心接待客旅；
因为曾有接待客旅的，
不知不觉就接待了天使。
Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers
for in doing so
some have entertained angels without knowing it.
不可忘记用爱心接待客旅；
因为曾有接待客旅的，
不知不觉就接待了天使。
不可忘記用愛心接待客旅；
因為曾有接待客旅的，
不知不覺就接待了天使。
Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers
for in doing so
some have entertained angels without knowing it.
Take care to keep open house: because in this way some have had angels as their guests
without being conscious of it.
倘若你们在不义的钱财上不忠心，
谁还把那真实的钱财托付你们呢？
If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon
who will commit to your trust the true riches?
倘若你们在不义的钱财上不忠心，
谁还把那真实的钱财托付你们呢？
倘若你們在不義的錢財上不忠心，
誰還把那真實的錢財託付你們呢？
If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon
who will commit to your trust the true riches?
If
then
you have not been true in your use of the wealth of this life
who will give into your care the true wealth?
